textwithimage.text:
Arm® Cortex®-A35 based on i.MX8X

The Embedded Starterkit STKa8x is an evaluation kit designed for embedded computing engineers. It's built on the TQMa8x platform, featuring the Arm Cortex-A35 processor from NXP's i.MX8X series. This kit offers impressive graphics with 4K support and a Quad-Core processor. It supports full chip hardware virtualization and provides high-speed communication through 2x Gbit Ethernet, 2x PCIe, 1x SATA, and 1x USB 3.0 interfaces. Despite its capabilities, it maintains low power consumption, typically around 10 watts. Additionally, it boasts 2x Cortex-M4 CPUs for real-time and security applications, 2x CAN-FD, and integrated security functions.

text.text:
Features

  • Graphic with 4K Support: Ideal for applications demanding high-quality graphics with 4K support.
  • Full Chip Hardware Virtualization: Supports efficient hardware virtualization.
  • High-Speed Communication: Provides 2x Gbit Ethernet, 2x PCIe, 1x SATA, and 1x USB 3.0 interfaces for efficient data transfer.
  • Low Power Consumption: Maintains low power consumption, typically around 10 watts.
  • Integrated Cortex-M4 CPUs: Equipped with 2x Cortex-M4 CPUs for real-time and security applications.
  • 2x CAN FD: Offers 2x CAN-FD interfaces for versatile connectivity.
  • Integrated Security Functions: Enhances data protection and security for reliable operations.

Starterkit STKa8x set
 The core of the STKa8x set is the TQMa8x module with a Quad Cortex®-A53 CPU and a Dual A72 CPU. The components contained in the starter kit constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. Development of graphic interfaces can be started immediately using the prepared combination of closed display unit and starter kit that are matched to each other. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of the starter kit in your own designs.
